logline: Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.
continuity_notes: While Juliana faces trial and sentencing in the courtroom, this episode reveals Alexander's mother escaping confinement and tracking down Alexander in his mountain hideout, uncovering the dark treason that orchestrates both their fates.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot following an elderly hooded woman clutching an iron lantern as she stumbles anxiously through a damp subterranean stone tunnel.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander's mother, frail with silver hair under a dark hooded cloak, braces her hand against the rough stone wall, panting heavily in fear.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Determined, Breathless)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: I will not die in that house.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on her trembling, weathered hands gripping a mossy stone bolt set into a heavy iron plate on the stone wall.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: She uses all her strength to shove the stone bolt upward, disengaging the hidden lock mechanism.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy stone grating and metallic latch clanging as the lock releases.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The heavy stone doorway swings inward, and the elderly woman ducks low, crawling through the opening into the cold night outside.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide atmospheric shot of a deep, snow-covered pine forest at night. In the distance stands a small secluded log cabin nestled under towering snowy trees.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander's mother plods through the thick snow, leaning heavily on a wooden walking stick, her dark cloak dusted with snow.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Howling winter wind and crunching of footsteps in deep snow.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother arriving beside the frosted wooden door frame under sharp hanging icicles, shivering violently from the freezing cold.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Whispering, Weary)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: This must be the place.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on her wool-gloved hand unlatching the icy wooden door handle and pushing it open.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Creak of cold wooden hinges opening.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Panning shot from the open doorway revealing the warm, dimly lit cabin interior, settling on Alexander standing over a rustic wooden table by lantern light.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander, wearing a rugged trench coat, his scarred face framed by long dark hair, stands studying an unfolded tactical map before snapping his head up in alarm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander's mother stepping across the threshold, holding up her burning lantern, her eyes wide with shock.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing, Stunned)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Alexander!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Breathless, In Disbelief)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Mother?

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping, Overwhelmed)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: You're alive.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Choked Up)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Mother.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: I buried you.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Somber)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I know.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Anguished, Accusing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Resigned)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Most of them were.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Searching, Desperate)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Then how did you survive?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Quiet)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I wasn't supposed to.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Solemn)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steady, Focused)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shocked)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: A traitor?

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Firm)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: We were close to finding him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Hardened)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then came the ambush.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Bitter, Painful)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: My men were slaughtered.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: And you?

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Hollow)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I was shot. Left for dead.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Astonished)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: How did you escape?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Somber, Low)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Continuing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Then why did they never tell us?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Ominous, Deliberate)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Breathless)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Who?

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Brooding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I spent three years trying to find out.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: The ambush was not an accident.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Vehement, Enraged)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Darkly Intimating)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Someone wanted me erased.

segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Terrified)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
segments.text: Who?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Chilling)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on his mother's face as the horrifying realization hits her, her mouth open in a soundless gasp of sheer dread as the scene holds and slowly fades.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.
